body_markdown:
In a global climate marked by persistent geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty, Interparfums achieved solid performance in the first half of 2026 with consolidated sales of €431m at constant exchange rates and €414m at current exchange rates. This trend resulted from the robustness of several brands, including Coach and Jimmy Choo, as well as the good performance of certain key markets such as the United States and China.
